summary: RBAC restricts access by role within an organization; roles bundle least-privilege permissions assigned to resources, teams and users. Manage users, teams and organizations through the unified UI or platform gateway API, since changes via the legacy controller API can take up to 15 minutes to reach Event-Driven Ansible controller and cause authentication errors.
questions: How does role-based access control work in AAP?
Why can't a new user log in to Event-Driven Ansible?
Should I use the controller API or gateway API to manage users?
How long do controller API user changes take to sync to EDA?
